submission.comment: Found a moving average crossover strategy with volatility targeting that achieves an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.012. The strategy uses a 43-day fast SMA and 180-day slow SMA, going long when the fast SMA is above the slow SMA and short otherwise, with position sizing scaled by recent volatility. This was the best result after testing 264 strategy combinations across all 5 strategy families with various parameter ranges and modifiers.
